archetypes.name: dyn-oos-gate
archetypes.rationale: Validate pre-vote OOS classification, renumbering, and zero-findings routing.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on the new pre-vote OOS gate in python/review_pipeline.py. Check that OOS classification matches ballot parsing semantics and that in-scope findings are preserved and renumbered correctly. Pay special attention to all-OOS, validation-exhausted, and empty-merge paths. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-round-artifacts
archetypes.rationale: Audit durable artifact and parent-copy behavior around the new gate.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the pre-vote gate audit artifacts, parent-copy behavior, and run-log allowlist changes. Verify failure paths flush complete audit rows and do not silently continue after partial ballot or artifact writes. Check that dropped OOS remains audit evidence only and is not treated as accepted OOS. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
